units.passage: Acquiring AI-use skills is a valuable part of a student’s education.
units.why: "Acquiring AI-use skills is a valuable part of a student's education" is a professional-skill rationale for teaching effective AI use (P44), not a rule, so it is informs.

units.passage: Integrating ChatGPT in the classroom offers an innovative and effective approach to education, enhancing both teaching and learning experiences.

units.passage: Keep in mind that your practice with varied expectations across the University is itself good preparation for the varied norms you will encounter in the professional world.

units.passage: But what unites all professional endeavors is the expectation that employees understand the expectations of their field and exercise vigilance to ensure that generative AI use is within the guidelines established by the profession.

It states an expectation of professionals as part of the pre-professional rationale, so general, informs, P44.

units.why: Gives a rationale: prepare students "to use AI effectively, safely, and ethically" for "professional purposes". That is the learn-AI-as-professional-skill argument (P44).

units.passage: Technology changes quickly and academic institutions adapt slowly. It is our job to prepare you as well as possible for the future, and that means learning to use new technologies effectively but also responsibly.
units.why: The instructor's framing, "that means learning to use new technologies effectively but also responsibly", explains why the course teaches AI use; it is a rationale (informs) that teaches AI use as a professional skill (P44).

units.passage: My goal is to best prepare you for future professional scenarios where you might not always have immediate access to external resources.

units.passage: The course aims to introduce cybersecurity students to real-world uses of GenAI in the field through an emphasis on hands-on learning.

units.passage: Creating opportunities for students to interact with AI technologies, understand their underlying principles, and reflect on their implications fosters digital literacy and prepares them for the AI-driven world they will face.

units.passage: AI will increasingly shape the professions and communities into which our graduates enter.

units.passage: The most successful graduates in an AI-enabled world will not simply know how to use technology. They will understand the need to evaluate it, know when to challenge it, and the ways in which human judgment is indispensable.

units.passage: we are committed to providing our community with a clear understanding of how AI is reshaping the workplace and the professions our graduates will enter.
